done_when: tick --json has lanes.dsa per host with last_call_age_min from the newest BRIDGE signal; a stale (> 24 h) bridge sets dsa_down true; fail-first test with a fixture signal list.
goal: aibridge_health.py checks only the local agent, so a supervisor on the third device (or NB for the NUC bridge) cannot tell if DSA rows will ever be taken. Add: a model-free script that reads the last audit.jsonl call age on a host and sends one signal line BRIDGE host=<h> last_call_age_min=<n> up=<0|1>; supervisor.py tick shows it per host.
tests: tick --json has lanes.dsa per host with last_call_age_min from the newest BRIDGE signal; a stale (> 24 h) bridge sets dsa_down true; fail-first test with a fixture signal list.
title: Tandem: DSA bridge liveness visible to supervisors on other devices
